Photos & Glimpses

Photos from the NAOP 2027 brochure, including IIT Jodhpur, Jodhpur heritage sites, campus wildlife, and glimpses of the 35th NAOP Annual Convention.

About the Convention

The NAOP 2027 Annual Convention explores how positive psychology and emerging technologies can converge to unlock human potential in the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

Conference Theme

Human Potential 4.0: Positivity and Technology for a Flourishing Future. The theme asks what flourishing looks like when technology is deeply woven into daily life.

Dimensions

Positivity and technology are explored across individual, organizational, educational and cultural dimensions, including Indian and indigenous psychology.

Venue

IIT Jodhpur, Rajasthan, India. The institute's permanent campus spans 852 acres on the Jodhpur–Nagaur Highway.

Organizing Institutions

The convention is organized by the School of Liberal Arts, IIT Jodhpur, in association with the National Academy of Psychology (NAOP), India.

About IIT Jodhpur & SoLA

IIT Jodhpur

Established in 2008 by the Ministry of Human Resource Development, Government of India, IIT Jodhpur was one of the eight second-generation IITs. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs across 15 departments and 3 schools.

School of Liberal Arts

Established in 2022, SoLA evolved from the Department of Humanities and Social Sciences, established in 2015. Its expertise spans psychology, philosophy, economics, sociology, literary, cultural and cinema studies.

Happiness Initiative

Anand Pahal was founded in 2025 as a transdisciplinary, faculty-led programme advancing the science and practice of well-being, supported by the Rekhi Foundation. Its pillars are Research, Education and Outreach.

Conference Tracks

The listed focus areas are illustrative and non-restrictive. High-quality papers addressing any dimension of a track theme are encouraged.

TRACK 1 · DIVISION 6

Technology, Mental Health, and Human Well-being

Digital interventions, teletherapy, mental health apps, cyberpsychology, and clinical well-being in a hyperconnected world.

TRACK 2 · DIVISION 4

Positive Organizational Psychology, Leadership, and the Future of Work

Remote work dynamics, AI-driven leadership, workplace resilience, burnout prevention, and organizational flourishing in Industry 4.0.

TRACK 3 · DIVISION 1

Positive Education, Learning Sciences, and Human Development

Smart classrooms, growth mindsets, socio-emotional learning technologies, and life-span human development in digital learning ecosystems.

TRACK 4 · DIVISIONS 3 & 9

Human-Centric AI, Cognitive Science, Military Psychology, and Ethics

Neuroergonomics, human factors in high-stress environments, cognitive computing, ethical AI frameworks, defense psychology, and HCI.

TRACK 5 · DIVISIONS 2 & 5

Community Flourishing, Diversity, and Cultural Practices

Social cohesion, identity, digital equity, systemic resilience, and cross-cultural adaptations to global technological shifts.

TRACK 6 · DIVISION 11

Indian Psychology, Indigenous Knowledge Systems, and Bharatiya Perspectives

Traditional Indian philosophical frameworks, mindfulness, Bharatiya roots, and modern psychological practices.

TRACK 7 · DIVISIONS 7 & 12

Methodological Innovations, Assessment, and Qualitative Inquiry

Big data in psychometrics, computational psychology, digital assessments, qualitative innovations, and open-science frameworks.

TRACK 8 · DIVISIONS 8 & 10

Foundations of Psychological Science, Personality, and Social Issues

Core psychological architectures, personality theories, baseline behavioral models, macro social dynamics, and critical public issues.

Pre-Conference Workshops

Science of Happiness and Well-being

Proposed by the Happiness Initiative (Anand Pahal), SoLA, IIT Jodhpur. Participants will gain exposure to frameworks for measuring and cultivating happiness, resilience, and psychological well-being.

Other Proposed Workshops & Symposia

Planned themes include AI and human-centric technology in psychological research, qualitative and computational research methods, and Indian and indigenous approaches to well-being. Dates, facilitators and eligibility will be announced closer to the convention.

Call for Papers & Awards

Call for Papers

Original research papers, conceptual studies and case studies are invited according to the conference tracks. The abstract template and submission guidelines will be updated in the second announcement.

Publication

Selected papers will have the opportunity to be published in Scopus- and ABDC-indexed journals. Outstanding papers may also be considered for edited book chapters.

NAOP Awards

Prof. D. Sinha Dissertation Award

Recognizes exemplary doctoral research contributing significantly to psychology and its impact.

NAOP Best Paper Awards

Honors outstanding research papers presented at the convention.

Prof. M. B. Saran Award

Celebrates extraordinary contributions to applied psychology.

Emerging Psychologist Session

Recognizes promising early-career psychologists with exceptional potential for impactful contributions.

Detailed award procedures will be updated in upcoming announcements.
